Why Stratex exists

Talent is everywhere. Good evidence is not.

Grassroots football holds valuable knowledge about players, but it is often trapped in conversations, scattered files and local networks.

We are building the infrastructure that helps the right football information travel further.

02

03

Better records can help families, coaches and decision-makers understand a player earlier.

ScoutLink turns local football knowledge into structured evidence.

Coach-led player records. Reviewed scout access. Explainable decision support.

VISIBILITY SHOULD NEVER MEAN UNCONTROLLED EXPOSURE.

Stratex builds youth-football products around reviewed access, coach-led profiles, adult-mediated communication and clear concern routes.

Report a concernRead security
SAReviewed accessCoach-led recordsAdult-led contactVisible concern routes
Trust principles

Practical controls, not vague promises.

These principles apply across ScoutLink, public forms and live events.

01

Reviewed access

Scout applications are assessed before player-search tools are activated.

02

Coach-led records

Youth-player information is maintained by authorised adults or organisations.

03

Controlled visibility

ScoutLink is not an open public directory.

04

Adult-mediated contact

Interest moves through coaches, clubs, schools or guardians.

05

Responsible scoring

Compatibility does not guarantee selection or contracts.

06

Clear escalation

Safeguarding, conduct, privacy and access concerns have public routes.

Scout verification

Access begins with information that can be reviewed.

Identity, role and safeguarding information are reviewed before youth-player search.

01

Application

Personal, organisation and role information.

02

Secure documents

Proof of identity and requested DBS or safeguarding evidence.

03

Internal review

Approve, decline or request clarification.

04

Ongoing accountability

Restrict access when roles or risk conditions change.

Parents and guardians

Plain-English control and concern routes.

Families should understand who manages the profile and how to ask for action.

✓

✓

✓

✓

Stratex is not an emergency service.

Contact emergency services or the appropriate safeguarding authority first where somebody may be at immediate risk.

How to build a player profile scouts can actually use

A useful profile helps a reviewer understand the football context, evidence strength and next action.

Stratex Analytics8 minute readUpdated July 2026
In this guideStart with the roleUse repeated evidenceExplain confidenceChoose useful video
For coaches

ScoutLink coach accounts are free.

Register as coach

The best profile is not the one with the most information. It is the one that makes the important football information easy to understand.

Start with the football role

Position alone is not enough. Explain responsibilities, current fit and the role the player may be developing towards.

“Centre forward” tells the reader where the player stands. Role evidence explains what the player contributes.

Use repeated evidence

Repeated Match Facts, ratings and video create a clearer picture than one exceptional match.

Explain evidence confidence

A profile based on two matches should not look as certain as one supported by repeated current evidence.

Choose useful video

Approved video should show decisions and movement, not only the final action.

Keep the profile current

A small weekly routine is more useful than a large update completed once.

Create player records, fixtures and Match Facts from the free coach workspace.

Legal and privacy

Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 2026. This page explains how Stratex Analytics handles information across its website, ScoutLink, careers and live-event routes.

On this pageWho we areInformation we collectChildren and youth-player informationWhy we use the informationLawful basesWho can access informationService providers and transfersAnalytics and sensitive formsDecision-support systemsRetention and deletionYour rights and complaintsContactContact Stratex
Youth-player data requires particular care.

Visibility, consent, access control and adult-led routes must remain part of the full product and event workflow.

Who we are

Stratex Analytics Limited is the company behind the Stratex public website, ScoutLink, careers, learning content and showcase-event operations. The relevant Stratex entity acts as controller for the personal data described here.

Information we collect

We may collect contact and organisation details, public-form submissions, ScoutLink account and activity records, youth-player profile information, Match Facts, approved video, careers applications, event registrations, concern reports and technical security records.

Children and youth-player information

ScoutLink and showcase events involve players under 18. Player information must be submitted by an authorised adult or through the applicable consent and contact process. Parents and guardians can raise questions, corrections and removal requests.

Why we use the information

Purposes include operating products and events, responding to enquiries, reviewing scout access, supporting safeguarding, maintaining security, administering recruitment, improving services and meeting legal obligations.

Lawful bases

Depending on the activity, Stratex may rely on contract, legitimate interests, consent, legal obligations and the protection of vital interests. Consent can be withdrawn where consent is the applicable basis.

Who can access information

Access is role-based. Coaches access authorised teams, reviewed scouts use permissioned workflows and Stratex staff access only the records needed for their responsibilities.

Service providers and transfers

Stratex uses trusted providers for hosting, database, email, analytics and storage. Contracts and security controls are used where providers process personal information, including where international transfers apply.

Analytics and sensitive forms

Analytics may be used to understand page and product usage. Concern descriptions, private messages, CV files, verification documents and sensitive form content should not be sent to product analytics tools.

Decision-support systems

Compatibility and prediction tools support football review. They do not make final selection, trial, signing, employment or safeguarding decisions.

Retention and deletion

Records are retained only for as long as needed for the relevant purpose, legal obligations, security, safeguarding, support or recruitment administration.

Your rights and complaints

People may have rights to access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection and data portability. Concerns may also be raised with the UK Information Commissioner where applicable.

Contact

Privacy questions and rights requests can be sent to info@stratexanalytics.co.uk.

No guaranteed football outcome.

Registration, a player profile, a score or an event application does not guarantee selection, scouting, a trial, a contract or professional football.

Who these terms apply to

These terms apply to visitors to Stratex public pages, ScoutLink users, career applicants, showcase-event registrants and people using public forms.

Account eligibility and accuracy

Users must choose the correct account type, provide accurate information and keep their details current. Scout and administrative access may require additional review.

Youth-player permissions

Coaches, teams, schools and other adults must hold the appropriate authority before adding youth-player information, video or event registrations.

Scout verification

Scout applications, identity, role and requested safeguarding information may be reviewed before access is activated. Access may be refused, suspended or removed.

Acceptable use

Users must not scrape, mass-download, resell, misuse or share player information outside authorised workflows; impersonate another person or organisation; bypass security; or use the service unlawfully.

No direct contact with minors

ScoutLink does not permit open adult-to-child recruitment messaging. Interest must remain coach, club, school, academy or guardian mediated.

Decision support and outcomes

ScoutLink compatibility, predictions, rankings and reports support judgement. Stratex does not guarantee scouting, selection, trials, contracts, professional outcomes or future performance.

Content and intellectual property

Users remain responsible for content they submit and their authority to submit it. Stratex software, scoring systems, product design, brand and materials remain protected intellectual property.

Availability and changes

Products, events, pricing, limits and features may change. Stratex will aim to communicate material changes where appropriate.

Suspension and termination

Access may be limited where verification fails, permissions are disputed, safety concerns arise, payment is overdue or these terms are breached.

Liability and governing law

Stratex provides decision-support products and does not control third-party football decisions. These terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales.

Contact

Questions about these terms can be sent to info@stratexanalytics.co.uk.

Cookie Policy

Last updated: July 2026. How Stratex uses cookies and similar technologies across public and product routes.

On this pageWhat cookies areEssential cookiesAnalyticsPreferencesThird-party servicesManaging cookiesChanges and contactContact Stratex

What cookies are

Cookies and similar technologies are small files or identifiers used to support sessions, remember choices, protect services and understand how pages are used.

Essential cookies

Essential technologies support secure sessions, navigation, role-based access, form protection and core product operation. Some parts of the service may not work without them.

Analytics

Stratex may use privacy-conscious analytics to understand visits, journeys and product usage. Analytics should not receive concern descriptions, private messages, CV files, verification documents, names, emails or phone numbers from sensitive forms.

Preferences

Preference technologies may remember settings such as interface choices where implemented.

Third-party services

Hosting, email, database and analytics providers may set or receive technical identifiers where needed to provide their service.

Managing cookies

Browser settings can be used to delete or block cookies. Blocking essential technologies may prevent secure or personalised areas from working.

Changes and contact

This policy may be updated when technologies or legal requirements change. Questions can be sent to info@stratexanalytics.co.uk.

Trust and security

Security

Last updated: July 2026. A plain-language overview of how Stratex protects website submissions, ScoutLink accounts and restricted files.

On this pageOur approachServer-side submissionsDatabase and permissionsPrivate filesEncryption and secretsAuthentication and access reviewLogging and auditMonitoring and incident responseUser responsibilitiesReporting a vulnerabilityContact Stratex
No security system is perfect.

Stratex does not claim absolute security, but designs access, storage and response processes to reduce risk and support accountable action.

Our approach

Stratex uses layered technical and organisational controls appropriate to an early-stage football-technology platform handling public forms, user accounts and youth-player information.

Server-side submissions

Public forms submit through backend routes rather than exposing privileged database credentials in the browser.

Database and permissions

Supabase service-role credentials remain server-side. Row-level security, role-based access and permission checks should restrict who can view or change records.

Private files

CVs, scout-verification documents, approved player video and other restricted files should remain in private storage and be accessed through authorised or time-limited routes.

Encryption and secrets

Connections use HTTPS in transit. Secrets and privileged keys should be stored outside public source code and rotated where compromise is suspected.

Authentication and access review

Accounts use secure authentication. Scout and internal access may be reviewed, limited or removed when roles, organisations or risk conditions change.

Logging and audit

Security, safeguarding and administrative activity may be logged with timestamps, user roles and affected record identifiers to support investigation and accountability.

Monitoring and incident response

Stratex reviews reported issues and may restrict affected routes, reset credentials, preserve relevant evidence and notify people or authorities where legally required.

User responsibilities

Users should protect login details, use authorised devices, avoid sharing restricted information and report suspected misuse quickly.

Reporting a vulnerability

Security concerns should be sent to info@stratexanalytics.co.uk with enough detail to reproduce and assess the issue. Do not access or retain data beyond what is necessary to report the problem.

Accessibility statement

Accessibility

Last updated: July 2026. How Stratex approaches inclusive public, product and event-registration experiences.

On this pageOur commitmentStandards and approachKeyboard accessScreen readers and structureText, zoom and reflowColour and contrastForms and errorsKnown limitationsFeedback and alternative formatsResponseContact Stratex

Our commitment

Stratex aims to make its public website and ScoutLink usable by as many people as possible, including keyboard, screen-reader, low-vision and mobile users.

Standards and approach

The team aims to follow recognised accessibility guidance, including WCAG principles, without claiming formal certification where a full audit has not been completed.

Keyboard access

Navigation, forms, dialogs and actions should be usable without a mouse. Focus order and visible focus states should remain clear.

Screen readers and structure

Pages should use meaningful headings, labels, landmarks, button names and status messages. Important information should not depend only on colour or visual position.

Text, zoom and reflow

Content should remain readable when text is enlarged and pages should reflow on smaller screens without avoidable horizontal scrolling.

Colour and contrast

Text and interactive controls should use readable contrast. Colour can support meaning but should not be the only indicator of status.

Forms and errors

Fields should have clear labels, instructions and error messages. Validation should explain what needs to change.

Known limitations

Some complex data views, third-party content or rapidly changing product areas may have limitations. Stratex intends to prioritise issues that block access to important tasks.

Feedback and alternative formats

Accessibility problems or requests for an alternative format can be sent to info@stratexanalytics.co.uk with the page, device and issue described.

Response

Stratex will review reported barriers, acknowledge where possible and explain planned action or a practical alternative.

What the showcase is

A serious opportunity platform, not a casual trial day.

The event combines structured football activity, live observation, safe event operations, networking and content capture.

01

Selected player applications

Players apply individually and the Stratex team reviews the football profile before confirming who has been chosen.

02

Live football evidence

Coaches and scouts see decisions, movement and behaviour beyond a written profile or isolated clip.

03

Controlled professional access

Coach and scout places are limited and attendance is recorded before the event.

04

Parent and guardian awareness

Youth participation, travel and event permissions remain part of registration and event operations.

Why we run it

Digital evidence should lead to real football relationships.

The showcase builds credibility, creates useful content, strengthens coach and scout relationships and gives selected players a controlled moment to perform live.

How the day works

Clear preparation before anybody arrives.

Applicants and football professionals receive the right information for their role.

01

Apply

Players submit football information. Coaches and scouts submit professional and attendance details.

02

Review

Player profiles are reviewed. Successful players receive an email and phone call confirming selection.

03

Prepare

Confirmed attendees receive the schedule, arrival information and event guidance.

04

Showcase

Players take part in structured football activity while invited coaches and scouts observe live.

05

Follow up

Stratex manages communication, content, relationships and appropriate next steps.

How often we run showcases

Quarterly, regional and deliberately controlled.

Showcase Days are intended as selected regional events rather than an open weekly trial circuit.
